हेलो! मैंने Kuku FM (Android)  पर यह शो सुना और मुझे यकीन है कि आपको भी यह जरूर पसंद आएगा।

show.description: When a comatose heir is married to a so called cursed girl to save his life, destiny tears a powerful family apart. His revival sparks his elder brother’s jealousy, twisting blood ties into rivalry. Between love, betrayal, and redemption, Accidental Shaadi explores how fate, family, and power collide in a battle of hearts and egos. Watch now.
